q: $${\left( {\frac{{{x^b}}}{{{x^c}}}} \right)^{\left( {b + c - a} \right)}}.$$ $${\left( {\frac{{{x^c}}}{{{x^a}}}} \right)^{\left( {c + a - b} \right)}}.$$ $${\left( {\frac{{{x^a}}}{{{x^b}}}} \right)^{\left( {a + b - c} \right)}}$$ = ?
s: $$\begin{aligned} & {\text{Given Exp}}{\text{.}} \\ & = {x^{\left( {b - c} \right)\left( {b + c - a} \right)}}.{x^{\left( {c - a} \right)\left( {c + a - b} \right)}}.{x^{\left( {a - b} \right)\left( {a + b - c} \right)}} \end{aligned}$$ $$= {x^{\left( {b - c} \right)\left( {b + c} \right) - a\left( {b - c} \right)}}.$$ $${x^{\left( {c - a} \right)\left( {c + a} \right) - b\left( {c - a} \right)}}.$$ $${x^{\left( {a - b} \right)\left( {a + b} \right) - c\left( {a - b} \right)}}$$ $$\begin{aligned} & = {x^{\left( {{b^2} - {c^2} + {c^2} - {a^2} + {a^2} - {b^2}} \right)}}.{x^{ - a\left( {b - c} \right) - b\left( {c - a} \right) - c\left( {a - b} \right)}} \\ & = {{x^0} . {x^\left( -ab + ac - bc + ba - ca + cb \right)}} \\ & = \left( {{x^0} \times {x^0}} \right) \\ & = \left( {1 \times 1} \right) \\ & = 1 \end{aligned}$$

s: $$\begin{aligned} & a + b = \frac{{\sqrt 5 + 1}}{{\sqrt 5 - 1}} + \frac{{\sqrt 5 - 1}}{{\sqrt 5 + 1}} \\ & = \frac{{{{\left( {\sqrt 5 + 1} \right)}^2} + {{\left( {\sqrt 5 - 1} \right)}^2}}}{{\left( {\sqrt 5 - 1} \right)\left( {\sqrt 5 + 1} \right)}} \\ & = \frac{{2\left[ {{{\left( {\sqrt 5 } \right)}^2} + 1} \right]}}{{5 - 1}} \\ & = \frac{{2\left( {5 + 1} \right)}}{4} \\ & = 3 \\ & a.b = \frac{{\sqrt 5 + 1}}{{\sqrt 5 - 1}} \times \frac{{\sqrt 5 - 1}}{{\sqrt 5 + 1}} = 1 \\ & {\text{Put value in expression}} \\ & \frac{{{a^2} + ab + {b^2}}}{{{a^2} - ab + {b^2}}} \\ & = \frac{{{{\left( {a + b} \right)}^2} - ab}}{{{{\left( {a + b} \right)}^2} - 3ab}} \\ & = \frac{{{3^2} - 1}}{{{3^2} - 3}} \\ & = \frac{{9 - 1}}{{9 - 3}} \\ & = \frac{4}{3} \end{aligned}$$
